findings.summary: The restaurant-issued current menu has no allergen chart, legend, cross-contact policy, or item-level allergen declarations. Consequently, its menu descriptions cannot validate the frozen full direct-allergen arrays; allergen availability is accurately unavailable for every reconciled food item.
The frozen baseline includes homepage/jobs promotional text rather than menu items; these rows should not appear as food records.
“Rich bread pudding with bourbon glaze • Whole 9in pan” is the description of the current Bourbon Bread Pudding menu item, not its menu-item name.
Chicken & Waffles appears in both the Lunch & Dinner and Brunch portions of the current menu, while the frozen row has the Brunch category paired with a Lunch & Dinner variant group.

summary: Identity and current public menu presence are verified from restaurant-issued pages. The baseline contains five non-menu extraction artifacts, Chicken & Waffles has a menu-scope variant inconsistency, and the public source lacks sufficient allergen disclosures to verify the frozen allergen arrays.
